'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Turd Ferguson LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Turd Ferguson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet player field reads '''Turd Ferguson''' (South Park joke alias); secondary overwritten ink is ambiguous (OCR variously McDevitt/Runelink/etc.). Published under the clearly written name.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Turd Ferguson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
